cloudfront_distribution_id.description: CloudFront distribution ID — needed to create cache invalidations.

cloudfront_url.description: CloudFront HTTPS URL — use this to access the site when no custom domain is configured.

custom_domain_url.description: Custom domain URL (only set when domain_name variable was provided).

order_id.description: AspenX order ID for this deployment.

private_db_subnet_ids.description: Private DB subnet IDs (RDS placement — no internet route).

public_subnet_ids.description: Public subnet IDs (CloudFront origin / future app tier).

rds_endpoint.description: RDS PostgreSQL hostname:port — use from within the VPC.

rds_security_group_id.description: Security group ID attached to RDS — add ingress rules here to allow application access.

tag_filter_command.description: AWS CLI command to list all resources tagged with this OrderId — use this for manual cleanup.

website_bucket_name.description: S3 bucket name — upload your static site files here.

alarm_description.constant_value: CloudFront 4xx error rate exceeded 20% for 15 minutes
CloudFront 5xx error rate exceeded 5% for 10 minutes
RDS CPU utilization exceeded 80% for 10 minutes
RDS free storage dropped below 2 GB

description.constant_value: Allow PostgreSQL access from within the VPC only

db_instance_class.description: RDS instance class. Locked to small prototype sizes only.

db_password.description: RDS PostgreSQL master password. Must be at least 16 characters. Never commit this value to source control — pass via terraform.tfvars or an environment variable (TF_VAR_db_password).

domain_name.description: Optional custom domain name (e.g. example.com). Leave empty to skip ACM and Route53. A Route53 hosted zone for this domain must already exist in the account.

project_name.description: Short project name prefix used in resource names.
